finalText: Migration's done. 12 leftover files were still calling `db.query` — all repo/service/admin modules across accounts, billing, analytics, support, catalog, and orders. Each is now on `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern the rest of the codebase already uses. The vendored ORM adapter and the unrelated cache layer were left untouched, and `verify.js` confirms everything checks out.
